text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Teach you the ropes of a European 
expedition... you say?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Sí! Precisely because Sirius-senpai
knows 
overseas racing best! That is why El is 
asking you, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What El aims for is—
a six-month expedition 
to France! To prove El is the world's 
strongest, El's heart is blaziiing, 
deeeesu!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...A long-term overseas expedition, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Heheheh, in that case—

One day, I came across El Condor Pasa 
eating a meal with an
uncharacteristically 
glum expression.
choice_data_list: What's wrong? Do you not have an a...
What's wrong? Do you not have an a...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh~... Actually, as advice for the 
European expedition, I was told to 'eat 
only French cuisine for every meal.'
choice_data_list: What's the matter? Not feeling hungry?
What's wrong? Don't have much of a...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The food is ¡está rico! El thought this 
would be a breeze... or so El thought...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
French cuisine... has practically ZERO 
super-spicy dishes, deeeesu!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If El adds El's special hot sauce, it 
would instantly turn into El's favorite 
food! However...
could that truly still be 
called French cuisine?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If El is to take Sirius-senpai's
challenge 
head-on! Then El must not use hot sauce 
here!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...That being said, without that 
passionate heat, El's El-El Power is... 
haah...
choice_data_list: If only there were super-spicy Fre...
If only there were super-spicy Fre...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
! That's it,
El just had a brilliant idea! 
Nobody can stop El now, desu!
choice_data_list: I wish there were super spicy Fren...
It'd be nice if there were super s...

text_block_list.text:
...With that intensity, I got worried she 
might cause some kind of trouble, so I 
decided to follow her.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If France lacks super-spicy dishes— then 
El will just invent a brand-new 
super-spicy French dish, deeeesu!

Following her gaze, I see a French 
sandwich— and a mountain of mustard and 
black pepper.
choice_data_list: N-No way, you're not going to...!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What El seeks is a blood-pumping, 
thrill-seeking kick! So, of course—full 
power dump!!
choice_data_list: N-No way, not that...!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The original French cuisine,
'Ultra-Spicy! 
French Hot Sandwich' is complete, desu! 
Now then! Let us... dig in!!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... OOOOOOH!! There's a deathmatch 
going on in El's mouth...!!!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Passion, fire, fiery spirit!! This is 
truly the ultimate spice El has been 
looking forrr!!
choice_data_list: Are you sure you're fine with some...
Are you sure you're fine with some...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Sí! It's so muy rico! With this, even if 
I'm overseas——...
choice_data_list: Can you really handle it that spic...
Can you really handle it that spic...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha! No, I just thought I could eat 
this every single day!
choice_data_list: What's the matter?
What is it?

text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I saw El Condor Pasa 
calling out to Sirius Symboli.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I understand what you meant by your
advice 
now—— It was so I could adapt overseas, 
wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to long-term expeditions, 
some horse girls fall out of shape
because 
the local food doesn't suit them!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's why maintaining a diet that suits 
you is so crucial... That's what you 
meant, right!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, Sirius-senpai,
El has taken 
another step toward getting stronger!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch! So I can live up to your 
expectations——!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Aren't you completely clueless? 
There was just a little chick chirping 
nonsense, so I teased you a bit. That's 
all.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Watching you struggle so hard with French 
cuisine was pretty entertaining, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh, getting this worked up over simple 
food.
How far can you actually struggle, I 
wonder... Quite a spectacle.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¡Bueno! That's just what I want!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
All right!
I can't just stand around here! 
What else can I do to prepare for the 
French expedition...?
choice_data_list: How about developing a new super s...
Maybe learning about life in Franc...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Trainer from before! You're right, 
having a wide repertoire is very 
important!
choice_data_list: How about developing a new super-s...
Maybe we should learn about life i...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Next up is ginger ale made with French 
chili peppers! Care to try some with me?
choice_data_list: (...How spicy could this possibly ...

text_block_list.text:
Curiosity got the better of me, and the 
instant I took a sip,
an explosive wave of 
heat knocked me clean off my feet.
choice_data_list: (...Just how hard must it be...?)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's ready! Special modanyaki made with 
chili pepper noodles!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Wait,
isn't this NOT French cuisine?! I 
had so much fun making it spicy that I 
completely forgot the original point...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Trainer from before! Indeed, "When in 
Rome, do as the Romans do!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Laurel's French class is now in session~♪ 
In France, most shops are closed on 
Sundays, and——

El Condor Pasa dedicated herself to 
studying seriously in preparation for her 
expedition to France.
